reason: The defined periocular tumour location supports ocular; intracranial or other neurologic involvement is not established by meningioma histology alone.
Cortical myoclonus and epilepsy define neurologic disease. Tremor and myoclonus do not establish skeletal muscle damage.
Hairy cell leukemia is a blood-cell malignancy. Lymph node involvement does not itself establish lymphoma or require infectious_immune.
Congenital mumps establishes infection; the supplied evidence does not establish defining salivary gland disease or common direct damage to another organ.
Thiamine deficiency and encephalopathy support metabolic_endocrine and neurologic. Ophthalmoplegia reflects neurologic injury rather than direct eye damage.

The pituitary tumour defines metabolic_endocrine. Very frequent GH-mediated skeletal changes and destructive arthropathy support musculoskeletal involvement; skin thickening alone does not establish functional damage.
The tumour affects the trigeminal ganglion, establishing neurologic origin. Broad head and neck ancestry does not establish gastrointestinal or pulmonary involvement.
Acute isoniazid poisoning is defined by seizures, impaired consciousness and metabolic acidosis. Hepatic injury is not established as a common feature of this acute poisoning syndrome.
Chronic bile duct inflammation defines hepatic disease. Inflammation alone does not establish an infectious, autoimmune or immune-mediated mechanism.
The tumour arises in the endocrine pancreas, supporting metabolic_endocrine. Carcinoid ancestry does not establish exocrine pancreatic or other gastrointestinal involvement.
